sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Claims"."Policy_ID" AS e, SUM("Claims"."Amount_Claimed") AS m1 FROM "Claims" GROUP BY "Claims"."Policy_ID"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT AVG("s3"."m2") AS v FROM "s3") SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, ("s3"."m2" - "s4"."v") AS m3 FROM "s3" JOIN "s4" ON "s4"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s3"."m2" > "s4"."v" ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
why: total of amount claimed per Customer_Policies (by Policy_ID) (additive)
share of the all total of total of amount claimed (all level)
gap to the all average of total of amount claimed: share of the all total (all level)
